text:
maria_csm: FYI kicking off coordination for Zenith dedicated bring-up. Need to lock quota, autoscale bounds, and a short load test window. cc @alex_eng @dave_sre :wave:

alex_eng: thanks. do we have their expected rps / peak token throughput? I only have a spreadsheet with 50k monthly tokens.

olivia_cs: Zenith ops sent projected peak: ~5k QPS for short spikes, sustained 500 QPS on business hours, avg token length ~200. They want <200ms p95 for prompt-only calls.

maria_csm: ok noted. proposal: reserve 4 GPU instances initially, set autoscale max to 12, cooldown 120s. Can we validate cost and warmup time?

alex_eng: 4 -> 12 looks fine for short tests. warmup: model kv cache cold start ~8-12 minutes per replica under load. recommend prefix-warmup + cache prefill.

dave_sre: autoscale policy: scale_by_latency with target p95 180ms, min_instances=4, max_instances=12, scale_step=2. Add circuit-breaker to fallback to a smaller model variant when GPU latency >500ms.

sana_solutions: adding runbook items for customer enablement: 1) onboarding run through prompt patterns; 2) provide sample load profile json; 3) schedule joint warmup 30m before heavy traffic; 4) provide contact window.

alex_eng: load test plan (short):
```
- smoke: 5m @ 200 QPS
- ramp: 20m from 200 -> 2000 QPS (linear)
- soak: 10m @ 2000 QPS
- spike: 2m bursts to 5000 QPS
metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, OOMs, token throughput, gpu util
```

maria_csm: propose window Wed 10:00-11:30 PST with a rollback slot after 11:15. Zenith approval pending.

olivia_cs: Zenith ops confirmed Wed 10:00 PST for the test, they will have their app in test mode.

dave_sre: test checklist:
- confirm reserved quota provisioning
- KMS keys accessible for private logs
- tracing hook enabled to map requests->tokens
- warmup script executed: `scripts/prefill_kv.sh zenith`
- set fallback routes to smaller_model:v2

maria_csm: who will run the load test? alex? or do we coordinate with their perf team?

alex_eng: I can run the load driver. will use `rbw loadtest` from infra. sample command:
```
rbw loadtest --target zenith --profile zenith_ramp.json --concurrency 400
```

deploy-bot: Zenith-dedicated-cluster: PROVISIONED (4 instances) — region us-west-2 — cluster-id: zenith-ded-202603 

sana_solutions: great. small ask from renewals: capture any deviation in latency or token quality during test to feed into QBR. if anything looks off we'll flag potential renewal risk early.

olivia_cs: noted, we'll take notes on prompt regressions and any fallbacks triggered.

alex_eng: I'll post a short summary and the kpi snapshot in this thread after the run. planning to start warmup 09:45 PST.

maria_csm: perfect. tagging @dave_sre for on-call during run. :thumbsup: 

dave_sre: I'll be on-call 09:30-12:00 PST. If we see sustained p95 > 400ms, abort and failover to hosted endpoint.

maria_csm: thanks everyone — will update ticket CS-4182 with timeline and links.

alex_eng: quick note: remember to set the autoscale cooldown to 120s and check metrics aggregation window to 30s to avoid thrash.

olivia_cs: Zenith ops: please keep app traffic minimized outside the test window. otherwise we might skew results.

maria_csm: closing for now, will reopen thread with post-test notes. :white_check_mark:
